description: Use this when the user has an 8- or 10-digit US HTS code and wants the import duty, merchandise processing fee (MPF), harbor maintenance fee (HMF) and total landed cost for a customs value and quantity. Computes ad valorem, specific and compound rates from the current USITC schedule; other rate texts are returned as not computed. Does not include Chapter 99 additional duties (Section 232, 301, IEEPA), antidumping duties or taxes.

customs_value.description: Customs (transaction) value in US dollars, greater than 0 and at most 1,000,000,000, e.g. 12500.

entry_date.description: Planned entry date YYYY-MM-DD for the fee year, e.g. 2026-11-15. Default: today in New York.

freight.description: International freight in US dollars, added to landed cost, e.g. 1800.

hts_code.description: 8- or 10-digit HTS code, dots optional, e.g. 8712.00.25.00.

insurance.description: Cargo insurance in US dollars, added to landed cost, e.g. 120.

net_weight_kg.description: Net weight in kilograms when the rate is per kg, e.g. 950.

quantity.description: Quantity in quantity_unit, needed for specific rates such as cents per kg, e.g. 300.

quantity_unit.description: Unit of quantity: No. (items), pr. (pairs), doz., gross, kg, t, liter, m2, m3, bbl or head, e.g. No.

rate_column.description: general (normal trade relations, default) or column_2 for countries in HTS General Note 3(b), e.g. general.

transport.description: How the goods arrive, only as the user stated it; ocean adds the harbor maintenance fee, e.g. ocean. Never guess: omit when the user did not name a mode; HMF is then shown as a conditional line and not added to the totals.

name: estimate_landed_cost
title: Estimate landed cost
